summary: Wrote two newcomer-facing concept pages for the research console: 'Cheating on purpose: oracles, teachers and students' (the information boundary, why a privileged planner can only be a teacher or a diagnostic upper bound, and the ledger-recorded distillation failures) and 'Four ways a program can learn Drop7' (n-tuple networks, value/policy and NNUE-style networks, policy-gradient RL, and MCTS, each with its retained outcome). Added web/components/ConceptsC.tsx with six server-component SVG figures, including a split player-view/oracle-view of one position generated by a new script that plays the TypeScript engine in latent mode. Every quoted number is carried from docs/research/status.md, docs/research/history.md or docs/strategies.md with its cohort size and scoring era; figure shapes that no retained record supplies are labelled illustrative on their face.
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
